description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different models, specifically Greedy and RPG, applied to CodeLlama models of varying sizes (7B and 34B) across four metrics: EGP, TR-N, TR-S, and CCP. The horizontal axis represents the metrics, labeled as EGP, TR-N, TR-S, and CCP, with arrows indicating the direction of improvement (↑ for higher is better, ↓ for lower is better). The vertical axis is labeled "Performance" and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The chart displays grouped bars, with each group consisting of four bars representing the different models: Greedy (CodeLlama-7B) in blue, RPG (CodeLlama-7B) in orange, Greedy (CodeLlama-34B) in green, and RPG (CodeLlama-34B) in brown. For the EGP metric, the bars have approximate values of 0.0, 0.88, 0.6, and 0.98, respectively. For TR-N, the values are around 0.7, 0.47, 0.62, and 0.4. For TR-S, the values are approximately 0.68, 0.43, 0.46, and 0.3. For CCP, the values are around 0.4, 0.73, 0.7, and 0.93. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
